findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise and the volume of data encrypted under a single key.

No key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root full access to the key, which delegates key usage authorization to IAM and prevents least-privilege scoping of encrypt/decrypt and key-administration permissions for this log-encryption key.
